claims.text: The monoid axioms do not derive commutativity in equational logic, and adding commutativity does not trivialize the theory: x = y remains underivable. (Not "inconsistent": a pure equational theory always has a one-element model, so inconsistency in the usual sense is unreachable. The degenerate case the second conjunct excludes is trivialization -- every equation becoming derivable, which substitution would give from x = y.)

review.note: Independence over the trusted equational calculus Ampas.EL.Derives. The second conjunct rules out independence by TRIVIALIZATION -- not by inconsistency: in pure equational logic a one-element model always exists, so a theory cannot be inconsistent in the model-theoretic sense, and the degenerate case to exclude is that every equation becomes derivable. If x = y were derivable, substitution would make any two terms equal. The earlier wording said "inconsistent" and was corrected on the reviewer's finding (2026-10-13). Reviewer also observed that the calculus has no separate constructor for substituting into a DERIVED equation, but that the rule is admissible by induction on derivations (compose substitutions at ax; refl/symm/trans/congr survive substitution), so no inferential power is missing.

claims.text: In the Hilbert system of AmpasRef.Defs, the A3 instance for p0 and p1 ((¬p0 → ¬p1) → (p1 → p0)) is not derivable from axioms A1 and A2 by modus ponens alone. Since a derivable schema would give every instance, this shows A3 is an independent axiom of the calculus.

review.note: Axiom independence, not theory independence: the statement is about the calculus Ampas.PL.DerivesPos (A1, A2, modus ponens; A3 absent) and says the A3 instance for p0, p1 is underivable from the empty theory. The reviewer confirms DerivesPos is the stated system minus A3, that Empty is the empty theory, and that a3_instance is the A3 schema at p0, p1. A proof for a different or weaker calculus is a different statement and the closure check rejects it. Guard: the claim is a refutation, so the non-vacuity and necessity guards do not apply; Ampas.Guards.pos_nontrivial instead shows the A1+A2 fragment still derives p0 -> p0, ruling out independence by a calculus that proves nothing.

review.confirmation_basis: 審查者逐條閱讀後接受（2026-10-13），依貼出的定義判定，未重新執行 Lean 核心驗證。原文判定：「DerivesPos 確實只移除了 A3；一個 A3 實例不可導出，足以證明 A3 公理模式不能由其餘規則導出。」審查者另給出獨立的分離語義：→ 取普通布林蘊涵、neg 解釋為恆真，則 A1、A2 永真且 MP 保真，而 p0=假,p1=真 時該 A3 實例為假。**審查者對 guard 的範圍提出限定**：同意 pos_nontrivial 可排除「空理論下完全沒有可導出公式」，但**不同意**把它當作「演算沒有被不當弱化」的充分證據——一個只能證出 φ → φ 的極弱系統也會通過該 guard。因此本條可接受的關鍵是演算定義逐項一致、加上 A3 實例的不可導出性；guard 僅為補充。審查紀錄已依此限定修正。
